EU Commission Targeted by AI-Powered Cyberattack

The European Commission was targeted in a cyberattack in October that utilized artificial intelligence, according to an official. The attack reportedly compromised personal data of employees. The European Commission has not yet commented on the incident. Separately, JPMorgan reported that third-party vendors were targeted in a cyberattack.
